title: Bound on proof tester seed count
statement: For every natural number $d$ and every list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations in $d$ variables over $\mathbb F_2$, the seed space of the associated quadratic-system proof tester has cardinality at most $2^{3(d+1)^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $d$ variables over $\mathbb F_2$
